=== FULL JOB DESCRIPTION ===
Associate Veterinarian

Pieper Veterinary Marlborough | Marlborough, Connecticut

Build Meaningful Relationships. Practice Exceptional Medicine. Be Part of Exciting Growth.

Are you looking for a veterinary practice where you can make a lasting impact on patients, clients, and your team? Pieper Veterinary Marlborough is seeking an Associate Veterinarian to join our thriving primary care hospital in Marlborough, Connecticut.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established practice with a loyal client base, supportive team culture, and a bright future ahead. Our hospital will soon be relocating to a brand-new facility, creating an enhanced environment for pets, clients, and team members while reinforcing our commitment to delivering exceptional veterinary care for years to come.

About Pieper Veterinary Marlborough

Pieper Veterinary Marlborough is a trusted primary care practice serving pets and families throughout Marlborough and the surrounding communities. As part of the respected Pieper Veterinary network and COVE Animal Health family, we combine the personalized feel of a community veterinary hospital with the resources, collaboration, and support of a larger veterinary organization.

Our team is passionate about providing comprehensive, compassionate care while building strong relationships with the families who entrust us with their pets. We believe great medicine starts with great people, and we've created an environment where veterinarians can thrive professionally while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

A Culture That Supports You

At Pieper Veterinary Marlborough, collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We foster a positive, team-oriented culture where veterinarians and support staff work together to deliver outstanding patient care and client service.

We believe in:

· Collaboration over competition

· Open communication and mutual respect

· Mentorship and professional growth

· Work-life balance and personal wellbeing

· Practicing medicine with autonomy and confidence

· Creating an environment where everyone feels valued

Whether you're an experienced veterinarian or a newer graduate seeking mentorship and support, you'll find a welcoming team committed to helping you succeed.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

Exciting Growth Opportunity

Our hospital is preparing to move into a brand-new facility designed to support exceptional patient care, team collaboration, and efficiency. This investment reflects our long-term commitment to the Marlborough community and the future of veterinary medicine.

Meaningful Medicine

As an Associate Veterinarian, you'll have the opportunity to practice high-quality primary care medicine while building strong, long-term relationships with clients and their pets. You will be supported by an experienced team that values preventive care, client education, and individualized treatment plans.

Professional Development

As part of the Pieper Veterinary network, you'll have access to a collaborative community of veterinary professionals, specialists, and leaders who are dedicated to clinical excellence and continuous learning. Whether your goals include mentorship, leadership development, or advanced clinical growth, we'll help support your journey.

What You'll Do

· Provide high-quality medical, surgical, and preventive care for small animal patients

· Build trusted relationships with clients through communication, education, and compassionate service

· Collaborate with veterinarians and support staff to ensure excellent patient outcomes

· Maintain accurate medical records and uphold the highest standards of care

· Contribute to a positive, supportive hospital culture

· Support initiatives that enhance patient care, client experience, and hospital operations

Why You'll Love Practicing Here

You'll be joining a hospital that's investing in both its people and its future.

Highlights include:

· Brand-new facility coming soon

· Modern equipment and updated workspace

· Strong technician and support staff team

· Collaborative and positive hospital culture

· Mentorship opportunities available (?)

· Flexible scheduling designed to support work-life balance

· Access to a larger network of veterinary professionals and specialists

· Leadership and career advancement opportunities

Compensation & Benefits

We believe exceptional veterinarians deserve exceptional support.

Benefits include:

· Competitive compensation package

· Relocation assistance available

· Safe Harbor 401(k) with up to a 4% employer match and immediate vesting

· Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

· Company-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage

· Professional liability insurance

· Generous continuing education allowance

· Professional development and mentorship support

· Paid licensure fees and professional memberships (AVMA, CVMA, and more)

· Equity opportunities available for eligible veterinarians

Why Marlborough, Connecticut?

Marlborough offers the perfect balance of small-town New England charm and modern convenience. Surrounded by scenic landscapes, parks, trails, lakes, and outdoor recreation opportunities, the area provides an exceptional quality of life.

Conveniently located between Hartford and the Connecticut shoreline, Marlborough offers easy access to major cities, cultural attractions, dining, and entertainment while maintaining the welcoming feel of a close-knit community.

Whether you enjoy hiking, boating, local farms, seasonal festivals, or simply a quieter pace of life, Marlborough is a wonderful place to live, work, and build a veterinary career.

Join a Team That Values Excellence, Compassion, and Community

At Pieper Veterinary Marlborough, you'll find more than just a job. You'll find a team that supports your professional goals, values your contributions, and shares your passion for exceptional veterinary medicine.

If you're looking for a place where you can build meaningful client relationships, practice high-quality medicine, and grow alongside an outstanding team, we'd love to hear from you.

New graduates seeking mentorship are encouraged to apply.
